description.value: Oakland-based software company, founded in 2014, that sells a feature management platform. Its core use is feature flagging, which separates deploying code from releasing features to users.

product_description.value: Feature management platform covering gradual rollouts, experimentation, targeted rollouts and A/B testing. Named product areas include Guarded Releases, AI Configurations, Experimentation and Release Management.

business_model_description.value: Subscription. Revenue comes from providing the platform to clients on a subscription basis.

customer_description.value: Over 5,500 enterprises, including a quarter of the Fortune 500 (per G2).

founded_year.value: 2014 (founded in Oakland, California, per CB Insights)

headquarters.value: 1999 Harrison Street Suite 1100, Oakland, California 94612 (per CB Insights)
